methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly via WebFetch and verified on 2026-06-18 for Deel (deel.com/pricing), Remote (remote.com/pricing), Oyster (oysterhr.com/pricing), Remofirst (remofirst.com/price), and Skuad/Payoneer WFM (skuad.io/pricing) — all per-unit prices confirmed exactly as drafted. Multiplier's pricing page (usemultiplier.com/pricing) returned HTTP 403; $400/employee/month EOR and $40/contractor/month were corroborated via the eorhq.com Multiplier guide and multiple 2026 third-party reviews citing the official page. Velocity Global redirected to hellopebl.com/pricing which is quote-only (page text: 'reach out to us directly for a custom quote'); Papaya Global (403, semi-transparent ranges only — third-party-estimated $650-770, not officially published), G-P (no published rate card, quote-only), and Rippling EOR (custom quote within platform) are all confirmed quote-only with monthlyUsd=null. Compliance: Deel SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR confirmed on deel.com/security; Remote SOC2 Type 2/ISO27001/GDPR confirmed on trust.remote.com; Oyster SOC2 Type II confirmed on official blog (GDPR per Oyster Trust Center, not the cited blog URL). No HIPAA stated by any vendor. Per-unit prices reflect the platform service fee only and exclude gross salary, employer taxes, and statutory benefits. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
